review_description: Having moved to outback Northern Territory I was concerned that getting solar installed on our house would be a tricky process.From start to finish the team at Northern Renewable Group were extremely professional.They provided a high quality system with high quality installation and looked after every step of the process for us.I would highly recommend Northern Renewable Group for all your solar needs.

Great service, simple breakdown of options from the engineer, install was delayed by weather - staff kept us in the loop though.This was a panel upgrade - added 9 panels to my 3kW system (has a 5kW inverter)Install finished today - doubled my output - happy!
Initial communication before installation was slowTechnicians were great - all installed in one day
